model_output.rationale: CO-29 timely filing denial on both lines, but the 277CA proves the claim was accepted 2025-01-27 — 8 days after the 2025-01-19 DOS. The payer's receipt-date determination is wrong. Reference: proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal, dispute the receipt date.

root_cause.explanation: Payer denied CO-29 but 277CA shows claim accepted 2025-01-27, only 8 days post-DOS. Filing was timely; payer's receipt-date determination is erroneous.

next_action.detail: Appeal with the 277CA acceptance report (2025-01-27, TRN TRC75364521) as proof of timely filing. Dispute the payer's receipt date — do not plead forgiveness.
